nodes.description: Immutable IFree interface handle to the Free0 NFT contract, set once in the constructor; all external NFT calls target this address.
Public mapping address => Stake storing firstStakeBlockNumber, secondStakeBlockNumber, mintBlockNumber and totalStaked ETH.
Public mapping tokenId => bool marking Free0 tokens already burned/consumed for a Free3 mint.
Privileged address that passes onlyAdmin and receives withdrawn stake ETH.
Immutable minimum block distance used in the secondStake and claim time windows.
Immutable block window length after which a stake stage is considered failed/expired.
Deploys Free3, wires the IFree address, immutable periods and initial administrator.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == administrator; guards transferAdministratorship and withdraw.
Admin-only setter that replaces the administrator address.
Payable function recording the first stake of at least 0.25 ether for msg.sender.
Payable function recording the second stake, only valid between stakePeriod and progressPeriodExpiration blocks after the first stake.
Admin-only function that refunds expired, unminted, still-staked ETH to the administrator.
Consumes a Free0 token to mint Free3 for msg.sender and refunds the staked ETH.
msg.sender in the constructor, assigned as the initial administrator (deployer becomes privileged).
msg.sender used as the key of addressToStakes in firstStake.
msg.sender used as the key of addressToStakes in secondStake.
msg.sender compared against administrator in the onlyAdmin modifier.
msg.sender in claim: must own the Free0, receives the minted Free3 and the refunded stake.
Native ETH transfer of stake.totalStaked to the administrator inside withdraw.
Native ETH transfer of stake.totalStaked back to msg.sender inside claim.
External call free.mint(3, msg.sender) to the Free0 contract during claim.
External call free.appendAttributeToToken(free0TokenId, 'Used For Free3 Mint', 'true') during claim.
External call free.ownerOf(free0TokenId) used to validate ownership in claim.
External call free.tokenIdToCollectionId(free0TokenId) used to validate the collection id in claim.
Constructor parameter holding the IFree contract address.
Constructor parameter assigned to the immutable stakePeriod.
Constructor parameter assigned to the immutable progressPeriodExpiration.
New administrator address written into the administrator state variable.
Storage pointer to addressToStakes[msg.sender] in firstStake.
Storage pointer to addressToStakes[msg.sender] in secondStake.
Staker address whose Stake record is read and zeroed in withdraw.
Storage pointer to addressToStakes[staker] in withdraw.
Boolean condition block.number > firstStakeBlockNumber + progressPeriodExpiration.
Boolean condition block.number > secondStakeBlockNumber + progressPeriodExpiration.
Boolean condition stake.totalStaked > 0.
Boolean condition stake.mintBlockNumber > 0.
Caller-supplied Free0 token id used as mapping key and forwarded to the external IFree calls.
Storage pointer to addressToStakes[msg.sender] in claim.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter freeAddr is written into the immutable free interface handle.
_stakePeriod is written into the immutable stakePeriod used for stake/claim windows.
_progressPeriodExpiration is written into the immutable progressPeriodExpiration.
msg.sender in the constructor silently becomes the privileged administrator.
onlyAdmin compares msg.sender against the stored administrator address.
The administrator state variable is read by the onlyAdmin guard.
newAdministrator is written to administrator; a single call transfers all privileges.
msg.sender indexes the addressToStakes mapping in firstStake.
msg.sender indexes the addressToStakes mapping in secondStake.
msg.sender indexes the addressToStakes mapping in claim.
firstStake's storage pointer aliases addressToStakes[msg.sender] and mutates it.
secondStake's storage pointer aliases addressToStakes[msg.sender] and mutates it.
withdraw's storage pointer aliases addressToStakes[staker] and zeroes totalStaked.
claim's storage pointer aliases addressToStakes[msg.sender] and writes mintBlockNumber/totalStaked.
firstStake reads the firstStakeBlockNumber flag and writes block number plus totalStaked.
secondStake reads firstStakeBlockNumber/secondStakeBlockNumber and accumulates totalStaked.
withdraw reads all Stake fields of the target staker.
claim reads and updates the Stake record of msg.sender.
firstStakeFailed is derived from stake.firstStakeBlockNumber.
secondStakeFailed is derived from stake.secondStakeBlockNumber.
ethStillStaked is derived from stake.totalStaked.
isMinted is derived from stake.mintBlockNumber.
block.number > firstStakeBlockNumber + stakePeriod computes a checked uint256 addition.
block.number < firstStakeBlockNumber + progressPeriodExpiration computes a checked uint256 addition.
secondStakeBlockNumber + stakePeriod bounds the claim window.
secondStakeBlockNumber + progressPeriodExpiration bounds the claim window.
Expiry comparisons add progressPeriodExpiration to the stored block numbers in withdraw.
Caller-supplied free0TokenId keys the free0TokenIdUsed replay-protection mapping.
claim checks free0TokenIdUsed before consuming the token, preventing double-mint.
free0TokenId is forwarded to the external free.ownerOf call.
free0TokenId is forwarded to the external free.tokenIdToCollectionId call.
free0TokenId is forwarded to free.appendAttributeToToken when marking the token used.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refunded stake in claim.
msg.sender is the mint recipient passed to free.mint.
administrator is the destination of the ETH transfer in withdraw.
stake.totalStaked read through the local pointer is the transferred amount.
The transferred value originates from addressToStakes[staker].totalStaked.
The refunded value in claim originates from addressToStakes[msg.sender].totalStaked.
The constructor initializes the immutable free handle.
The constructor assigns the initial administrator without any check.
The constructor sets the immutable stakePeriod.
The constructor sets the immutable progressPeriodExpiration.
onlyAdmin gates entry into transferAdministratorship.
onlyAdmin gates entry into withdraw.
firstStake declares the storage pointer stake.
secondStake declares the storage pointer stake.
withdraw declares the storage pointer stake.
withdraw evaluates firstStakeFailed inside its require condition.
withdraw evaluates secondStakeFailed inside its require condition.
withdraw evaluates ethStillStaked inside its require condition.
withdraw evaluates isMinted inside its require condition.
withdraw performs the ETH transfer to the administrator.
claim declares the storage pointer stake.
claim requires free.ownerOf(free0TokenId) == msg.sender.
claim requires free.tokenIdToCollectionId(free0TokenId) == 0.
claim marks the Free0 token as used via appendAttributeToToken.
claim mints the Free3 token through the external free.mint call.
claim refunds the staked ETH to msg.sender.
free.ownerOf is an external call to an externally-set contract that executes during claim and could re-enter.
free.tokenIdToCollectionId is an external call executed inside claim before the mint bookkeeping completes.
free.appendAttributeToToken is an external call executed inside claim and can transfer control to the Free0 contract.
free.mint is an external call in claim; a malicious Free0 implementation could re-enter Free3.
Native ETH transfer to the administrator in withdraw gives control to the recipient (gas capped at 2300).
Native ETH transfer to msg.sender in claim gives control back to the caller (gas capped at 2300).
